review_evidence: The unit contains 39 primary Lean files under PovuLean covering core graph structures, walks, GFA/VCF representations, Flubble/Hairpin algorithms, complexity, specs, examples, and correctness modules.
A source scan found 264 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declaration lines.

Representative results in PovuLean/Algorithms/FlubbleTree/Correctness.lean include chooseNearestParent?_some_sound, chooseNearestParent?_none_no_parent, buildHierarchyFrom_boundaries, and node-count bounds; the formal content is substantial even though the repository also has non-Lean implementation material.
summary: Retain the Povu Lean development: it contains explicit specifications and correctness proofs for graph/genomic-variation algorithms and data transformations.
